utility.notes: SCE's own 'Incorporated Cities and Counties Served by SCE' fact sheet (updated 3/17/2025) explicitly lists 'Beverly Hills' by name among the cities in its service area.

value.name: Clean Power Alliance (CPA) - 100% Green Power (default)
value.notes: Confirmed via a directly-fetched California Community Choice Association (CalCCA) press release: Beverly Hills is explicitly named among the communities that transitioned to 100% Green Power as their default CPA energy option beginning October 2022. Customers may choose another CPA option or opt out at any time.

county.notes: Beverly Hills is a well-documented Los Angeles County city; also listed under Los Angeles County in SCE's own service-area fact sheet.

permit_authority.value: City of Beverly Hills Development Services

interconnection_url.notes: SCE's own Net Energy Metering (NEM) program page — a utility-wide fact already established for other SCE-territory records this session.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Southern California Edison (SCE), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025. Administered by SCE across its entire distribution territory, which includes Beverly Hills/Los Angeles County.
value.eligibility: PG&E or SCE residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Same statewide CPUC-administered SGIP program already confirmed for other SCE-territory records this session, reused as a utility-level fact.

value.name: Completed Plan Review & Permit Application (over-the-counter pathway)
Contractor authorization letter (if application is not signed by the license holder)
Approved plans and issued permit must be available on-site during inspection

For ballasted (unattached, flat-roof) PV systems: seismic/wind compliance documentation per SEAOC PV1-2012 and PV2-2012, sliding friction testing, structural analysis, and a recorded maintenance affidavit

value: Schedule an inspection using the online CitySmart Portal
Limited next-day inspections available weekdays starting 9am, first-come first-served
Approved plans and the issued permit must be available on-site when the inspector arrives

value.program_or_pathway: SolarAPP+ (automated) / over-the-counter (systems under 10kW) / electronic plan review
other_conditions: Residential Solar PV systems under 10kW may be submitted and reviewed over the counter
Additional panels on an existing system, or ground-mounted installations, require contacting Development Services before applying via SolarAPP+
